messages:
Ana: FYI nightly eval flagged a big spike for the structured-output promptset, early-termination rate jumped ~7% vs yesterday. link: https://ci.redwood/insights/1788888888
Max: saw the alert, thanks. Which build?
Ana: `dedicated-quant-int8-packqv2` (artifact: gs://redwood-artifacts/packqv2/1788) — failing across both binomial and JSON-formatting prompts.
Jihoon: can you paste a couple of failed examples?
Ana: sure — example truncated mid-field:
```
Input: {"task":"extract","text":"..."}
Expected: {"name":"Alice","email":"alice@example.com"}
Got: {"name":"Alice","email":"alice@
```
Max: interesting, looks like stop sequence got injected early. Is the stop token different in the quant build?
Rachel: I pulled tokenizer logs from the failing run, there are cases where token id 50256 (``<|endoftext|>``) appears twice in a row after quant remap. snippet from kv trace: `... 50256, 50256, 12 ...`
Jihoon: double-EOS? that would definitely terminate generation early. How would quantization produce duplicate ids?
Ana: digging — the packqv2 remap step emits a `vocab_remap.json`. In a few artifacts that file shows an off-by-one for special tokens in the tail of the vocab. Example: `"50256": "50257", "50257": "50256"` (swapped).
Max: ohhh. so when the model outputs the normal EOS id it gets remapped to the other id, and the tokenizer normalization later maps both to EOS, producing an immediate extra EOS downstream.
Rachel: I replayed the single-model forward with both original and remapped vocabs: with remap, the next-step logits favor `50256` then `50256` again due to how the decoder handles remapped indices -> early stop. Without remap it's normal.
Jihoon: root cause candidate: packqv2's remapping script has a bug when handling truncated vocab shards — it shifts the tail by one when a reserved token lands on a shard boundary.
Ana: reproduce instructions I used: `python eval/repro/run_single_prompt.py --model gs://.../packqv2/1788 --prompt prompts/structured/json_field.json` — reproduces locally.
SRE Oncall: any customer impact? Which pools got the build?
Ana: only nightly and a small internal canary pool (0.5% traffic) — no external customer traffic yet, we gated promoted builds but the nightly eval picks it up.
Max: mitigation options: 1) immediate rollback of the packqv2 artifacts to previous pack (done?), 2) add CI gating tests that compare special token ids pre/post remap, 3) add a quick canary that runs structured promptset eval before promoting.
Rachel: I've started a rollback candidate: `packqv2/1787` -> patch pinned in staging. Deploy-bot: can you trigger a canary rollback to the internal pool?
deploy-bot: Triggering rollback to packqv2/1787 on canary pool (task id 9876). Will report status in 5m.
Jihoon: dev actions: fix remap script to detect shard-boundary shifts and add unit test that validates: for each reserved token in reserved_list, remap[token] == token (or explicit check that reserved token IDs are stable).
Ana: also adding an eval-gate: if any special-token id changes, fail the artifact promotion. Rachel, can you own that gating rule?
Rachel: yes, I'll add a pre-promote hook in the pack pipeline. Also adding a short promptset (50 prompts) smoke run that must pass structured-output acceptance (no early-termination >1%).
Max: long term: add a test that runs a diff of tokenized strings before/after remap for a curated list of edge prompts (escape sequences, multiline json, repeated EOS).
SRE Oncall: monitoring — set an alert on nightlies if early-termination delta >2% and page if canary >1%.
Ana: will update the incident doc: https://docs.redwood/incidents/1788888888-remap-eos-duplication (drafting root cause + fixes).
Jihoon: timeline: roll back canary — in progress, fix remap script (PR), add unit tests and gating rule, run nightly again, then re-run packqv2 on a test-only branch.
Rachel: estimated ETA for gating and unit tests: 24h. PR incoming shortly.
Max: thanks everyone. key takeaways: don't promote remap artifacts without token-id invariants checked; packqv2 needs boundary-aware remap logic.
Ana: closing loop: deploy-bot reports rollback success, canary now serving packqv2/1787, nightly re-run queued. I'll post follow-ups after the next nightly. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Rollback task 9876 succeeded.
eval-bot: Nightly structured-output eval queued (job 5591) — results expected in ~2h.
